//: Copy to your repo root as submission-check.config.json. Keys starting with // are comments and ignored. Delete what you don't need; every section is optional.
// docs: Globs relative to the repo root. Supports **, *, ?, {a,b}. node_modules/.git/dist/build/.next are skipped. Default: README.md, docs/**/*.md, SUBMISSION*.md
// domains: Every URL in the docs on these hosts (and their subdomains) must answer < 400. Bare hosts, no scheme.
// extraUrls: Claims that are not links on your domain but still must resolve: demo video, npm package, PyPI package, deployed API. A 404 on a package page is a failed claim ('npm i @myproject/sdk' in the README).
// ignoreUrls: Regexes for URLs that legitimately don't answer GET (POST-only APIs, auth-gated pages).
// forbiddenPageText: Regexes that must NOT appear in pages fetched from your domains. Catches the 'not deployed yet' fallback banner shipping to judges. Only sees server-rendered HTML.
// chains: One entry per chain your docs link to. rpc is tried in order (primary, then fallbacks) — public RPCs flake; give at least two. Link regexes: capture group 1 is the address / tx hash. blockscoutApi enables the verified-source check for deployments.
// deployments: Deployment JSON files (path or glob). addressesKey / txHashesKey are dotted paths (defaults: contracts / txHashes). Nested objects and { address } entries are flattened. Every contract needs code (+ verified if the chain has blockscoutApi); every tx needs receipt status 0x1.
// placeholders: Regex list (plain source or /source/flags). WARN normally, FAIL with --strict. Omit to use the defaults shown here.
// claims: Numeric claims that must agree everywhere. Capture group 1 is the number (commas OK). Make patterns specific — '(\d+) tests' also catches '14 tests that need a fork'. expected pins the truth; command computes it (only with --run-commands; last match of commandPattern in its output wins).
// tuning: Concurrency pool size, per-request timeout, attempts per request, base backoff (doubles each retry).
